title: Dorayaki Pancakes
attribution: Recipe adapted from Food Fusion (foodfusion.com). Not an official Food Fusion product.

steps.instruction: -Bareek cheeni (Caster sugar) 2 tbs or to taste
steps.romanUrdu: -Bareek cheeni (Caster sugar) 2 tbs or to taste

steps.instruction: -In a bowl,add eggs,honey,vanilla essence,milk,caster sugar & whisk well until sugar is dissolved.
steps.romanUrdu: -Bowl mein anday,honey,vanilla essence,doodh aur bareek cheeni dal dein aur cheeni dissolve ho janay tak ache tarhan whisk ker lein.

steps.instruction: -Add all-purpose flour,baking powder,melted butter & whisk until well combined.
steps.romanUrdu: -Maida,baking powder aur melted makhan dal ker ache tarhan whisk ker lein.

steps.instruction: -Grease non-stick frying pan with cooking oil,pour ¼ cup of prepared batter & cook on low flame until bubbles appear on the surface,flip & cook until done (makes 6).
steps.romanUrdu: -Non-stick frying pan ko cooking oil sa grease karein,¼ cup tayyar batter dal ker halki ancch per bubbles appear ho janay tak paka lein phir flip ker ka dosri side ko paka lein (makes 6).

steps.instruction: -In a bowl,add compound chocolate,cream & microwave for 1 minute then mix until well combined.
steps.romanUrdu: -Bowl mein compound chocolate & cream da ker 1 minute kliya microwave ker lein phir ache tarhan mix ker lein.

steps.instruction: -Add mixed nuts & mix well,cover with cling film & refrigerate for 15-20 minutes then mix well.
steps.romanUrdu: -Mixed nuts dal ker ache tarhan mix karein aur cling film sa cover ker ka 15-20 minutes kliya refrigerate ker lein phir ache tarhan mix karein.

steps.instruction: -Top one pancake with 2 tbs of prepared chocolate filling then cover with a second pancake & gently press to seal the edges.
steps.romanUrdu: -Pancake ka top per tayyar chocolate filling laga ker dosra pancake rakh dein aur edges ko gently press ker ka seal ker lein.

ogDescription: Kids favorite DoraYaki Pancake recipe. Try it this weekend with your kids and make cooking a fun activity. #digitalammi #pakistani #quickfoodrecipe
